quarterly_data.quarter: Micron press release: Micron Strengthens Automotive Ecosystem Supply Through (07-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Micron completed Strategic Customer Agreements (SCAs) with key Tier 1 suppliers and ecosystem partners of the automotive industry: Qualcomm, Visteon, HARMAN, JOYNEXT, DENSO, Astemo and Hyundai Mobis. The SCAs establish greater certainty around supply and pricing and give Micron and the partners greater visibility for production planning; Micron says they support investments in technology development, qualification and manufacturing capacity for future vehicle platforms. These agreements are among the SCAs discussed on Micron's fiscal third-quarter 2026 call.
